reserveReview.rationale: Issuer-document review at 2026-10-09T10:40:09Z still cannot establish a dated complete reserve allocation. APACX's mint guide states that all existing PHT use apcxUSDT backed 1:1 by USDT, while its transparency page lists only the apcxUSDT reserve wallet and says the apcxUSDC wallet is to be announced soon. Neither page publishes a dated branch-level collateral composition or a reserve-to-PHT reconciliation. Historical observations are retained without refreshing their clocks: Ethereum block 25648905 (2026-07-30T23:18:47Z) showed positive normalized debt in USDT-A, cPHP-A, ApcxUSDT-A, demoUSDT-A and USDC-A, and the July 30 Tronscan capture recorded 800002.000009 USDT in the named reserve wallet. Those old observations did not reconcile the multi-branch PHT claims and are not current holdings evidence. CompositionAsOf and the 100% insufficient-evidence placeholder remain unchanged; no complete composition, custody or financial-assurance credit is claimed.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: APACX collateral disclosure cross-checked against the live Ethereum Vat/ILK branch graph and the named Tron reserve wallet; branch balances and reconciliation remain undisclosed
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The complete current PHT vault inventory, branch-level collateral balances across USDT-A/cPHP-A/ApcxUSDT-A/demoUSDT-A/USDC-A, apcxUSDT underlying reconciliation, custodian identity, and any live apcxUSDC exposure are not published as a reconciled reserve snapshot.
